text.tspan: configures runs, supervises the cluster hand-off,
Deployment boundary: the web application and scientific orchestration run locally; only primary-protein annotation runs on LRZ.
The researcher can inspect every transfer command and the application never treats the cluster as an implicit web service.
dataset scoping, run control, JSON and guarded files
setup, routing, pre-cluster and post-cluster stages
roles, representative domains, distances, coordinate evidence QC
managed roots, bindings and hidden runs
